b06c728f385e31bb2480fc518074fb47e47d4290.summary: SecurityScorecard research page on the last version of REvil (Sodinokibi) ransomware. The text says the family has been active since 2019 with breaks due to law enforcement. It describes an RC4-encrypted configuration, killing a list of targeted processes, stopping some specified services, deleting Volume Shadow Copies, and targeting logical drives and network shares. Most of the page is site navigation. It names no actors, CVEs, sectors, countries or figures.

b0f478f447f65c4f77c981a3f5f3ce85274aa352.summary: A Netresec blog post by Erik Hjelmvik shows how the NetworkMiner tool decodes command-and-control traffic from a Triage sandbox run of njRAT, a remote access trojan. The post says njRAT has been around since 2013 and remains a popular backdoor. NetworkMiner can extract victim screenshots, transferred files, commands, replies, stolen credentials and keylog data. Decoding njRAT on non-standard ports requires the Professional edition.

b0cdf57ffe0f8d7999e42901c8cb1610d98c2c3a.summary: Malpedia entry (by Fraunhofer FKIE) for TwoFace, a two-stage ASP.NET webshell written in C#. A loader hides an encrypted payload that supports program execution, file download and deletion, and timestamp manipulation. The page credits Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 with the technical description, lists five associated actors, and gives a reference timeline from 2017 to 2022.

b0fd4b057e0870f90989522b08c3b5fab6611055.summary: On 2022-12-12 the U.S. and a coalition of allies formally attributed the Microsoft Exchange Server campaign to hackers affiliated with China's Ministry of State Security. The official said the attribution was made with high confidence and that the campaign hit hundreds of thousands of systems worldwide. Coalition officials named groups tracked as APT31 and APT40, and the DOJ charged four Chinese nationals over the APT40 group. Microsoft had earlier assessed HAFNIUM as exploiting Exchange vulnerabilities. The report also describes contract hackers and a ransomware attack on an American company.
